SVAMITVA scheme Madhya Pradesh Collateral vetting

Are the property cards actually being used as collateral?

SVAMITVA issues drone-surveyed property cards for village abadi land so owners can pledge them for bank loans. This audit checks whether that lending shows up on the land record. Across 2,667 abadi parcels examined — including every parcel of a village the PM showcased for a card loan — not one carries a registered charge. On the record, the cards are not functioning as collateral.

Until that sample is collected the village-level rate reads unknown — never zero. Collected via ror_sampler.py, aggregate-only, no owner data stored.

Reading the numbers honestly

  • Where a mortgage would show — the encumbrance field exists in exactly one form: the abadi RoR प्ररूप तीन (Rule 6) col 11, भूमि पर विल्लंगम तथा प्रभार (बंधक / दृष्टिबंधक). The agricultural khatauni प्ररूप सात (Rule 8) has no mortgage column at all — its columns 10–14 are land-revenue arrears, interest and dues. So the SVAMITVA card record is the only place card-collateral could appear.
  • What we found — col 11 blank on every abadi parcel checked (frame sample + a ~2,800-parcel positive-control search, including all 1,020 parcels of a PM-showcased loan village). The ror-detail JSON has no charge field either.
  • Specimen = ground truth — the "specimen copy" watermark is a legal- admissibility disclaimer (not valid as court evidence without the digital signature), not a data redaction; the signed copy renders the same record fields. So the zero is real: no sampled abadi parcel carries a registered encumbrance.
  • The one real caveat — col 11 shows charges registered on the record. A loan disbursed but never filed back to the abadi title would not appear — but that gap is itself the failure being vetted: a card that never carries its own charge is not a working collateral instrument.
  • Official card-backed loan counts are not published below the state level; the MP state figure itself is unverified and withheld. Aggregate-only, no owner PII stored.
Card census: svamitva.nic.in (state 23), scraped per village — vetted. Loan numerator: withheld pending a verified primary source.
